name: Transco Mid-South Expansion
researcher_notes: Transco Mid-South Expansion, FERC docket CP11-18, interstate, states AL, GA, SC, NC. EIA natural gas pipeline projects release of January 2020, sheet 'Historical Projects (1996-2019)', Excel row 268 (Phase 1): completed 2012-05-15, 22.59 miles, 42 inch, 95 MMcf/d additional capacity, cost 92.5 million USD. Staged in original units: 22.59 mi is about 36 km, above the 25 km add-threshold. Same row appears in the EIA releases from May 2018 through Jan 2020 and later. EIA is one origin; a FERC order for CP11-18 was not reachable here, so confidence is medium. The verifier confirmed the EIA file loads and names the project. Phase 2 (EIA row 236, completed 2013-06-03, Alabama only, 23 miles, 130 MMcf/d, 126.5 million USD) is NOT staged: a trade-press item (Australian Pipeliner, announcement of the expansion) describes about 23 miles of new pipe in five loops across both phases, so the Phase 2 length of 23 mi looks like the whole-project total and the 36 km figure may double count. Phase 2 length is uncertain, so it stays monitor (length) until a FERC document gives a per-phase figure. I could not read the article body from this environment, so it is not cited. No existing GEM row for Mid-South in the Transcontinental roster (checked all 21 Transcontinental segments). Owner/parent copied from the existing Transcontinental rows. Route not researched: no official GIS found; leave route unavailable, five loops.
